endorsements.name: Erik Daguerre
endorsements.label: CVE-2017-20198
endorsements.description: The Marathon UI in DC/OS < 1.9.0 allows unauthenticated users to deploy arbitrary Docker containers. Due to improper restriction of volume mount configurations, attackers can deploy a container that mounts the host's root filesystem (/) with read/write privileges. When using a malicious Docker image, the attacker can write to /etc/cron.d/ on the host, achieving arbitrary code execution with root privileges. This impacts any system where the Docker daemon honors Marathon container configurations without policy enforcement.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: CRITICAL (CVSS 4.0, 9.3)
